# TandemKit — LLM guide

> Swift port of the Tandem t:slim X2 / Mobi Bluetooth protocol (jwoglom/pumpx2). Builds messages,
> runs JPAKE pairing/auth, speaks BLE. Verified **byte-exact** against `vendor/pumpx2-oracle/`.
> A wrong byte can misdose insulin.

Thin map. Working guide: [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md). Oracle workflow: [`README.md`](README.md).
Pinned upstream + hardware log: [`PINNED.md`](PINNED.md). Branch policy:
[`../faBolus/BRANCHES.md`](../faBolus/BRANCHES.md).

- Products: `TandemMessages`, `TandemAuth`, `TandemBLE` (+ `TandemBenchHarness` executable).
- **Never change message bytes without a matching oracle-parity test.**
- `ResponseParser` dispatches on **(characteristic, opcode)** — opcodes are not globally unique.
- `WritePolicy`: `.readOnly`, `.allowBenignControl`, `.allowNonDelivery`, `.allowDestructive`,
  `.allowDelivery`. Don't reach for `.allowDelivery` when a lower tier suffices.
- Tests: `swift test` (JDK 17+ + built cliparser.jar for oracle parity; CI uses JDK 21).
